description: Given the specific cooling requirements of this track, a larger engine cover has been brought to the event to increase overall cooling capacity while maintaining high aerodynamic efficiency.

The removal of the straight mode actuator and circuit characteristic incentivises the addition of local devices to generate additional aerodynamic load.
